full_judgment: 16. P.W.5 Rezaul Karim, father of the deceased, deposed that he married the informant after divorcing Rokeya alias Lakki and thereafter he divorced the informant and started conjugal life with Rokeya alias Lakki. He deposed that a salish was held on 01.01.2005 in the house of Jurun Member. He stated in his cross-examination that it is his presumption that his first wife Lakki was involved with the killing. He denied the suggestion that his presumption is not correct. He admitted in his cross-examination that no one was identified a suspect in the general diary.
